Name: Cute Shape Elixirs for Mizu's Unicorn and Friends
Author: JennaJuffuffles
Description:
[b][size=4]100% of this mod's first month of DP will be contributed to Doctor's Without Borders as part of Nexu Mod's 25th Anniversary Mod Drive.[/size][/b]

[b][size=4][color=#c9daf8]Features ✧ °｡⋆✦･ﾟ ✧[/color][/size][/b]
[list]
[*]New unique looks for each of the three buff potions![/*]
[*][b]Important: [/b]Buff potions must be activated in Mizu's Unicorn and Friends for these to appear in game! (use GMCM)[/*]
[*]Purchase recipes from the Night Market to craft these using Unicorn, Pegasus and Qilin dropped items! (These are part of Mizu's mod!)[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=3]✧ Requirements ✧ [/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47474]Mizu's Unicorn and Friends[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menur[/url] (Optional, recommended to activate settings in Mizu's mod!)[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=3]✧ Permission ✧ [/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://i.imgur.com/T3r2MEM.png]Enthusiastic support[/url] given by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/MizuJakkaru?gameId=1303]MizuJakkaru[/url].[/*]
[/list]
